examples.title: Attach CameraTracker to source footage
examples.code:
# Track camera motion from an image sequence.
tracker = nuke.createNode("CameraTracker")
tracker.setInput(0, source)

examples.title: Create a solved camera with Foundry's helper
examples.code:
# After solving the CameraTracker, create a Camera from the solve.
tracker = nuke.createNode("CameraTracker")
# ...perform the track and camera solve...
nukescripts.cameratracker.createCamera(tracker)

provenance.editorial_note: The helper function is official Foundry API; it requires a solved CameraTracker.
